description: Narrowed wedding-dress demo: one bride, one designer look, three channels that genuinely haggle (resale / sample sale / made-to-order). The cross-channel spread IS the honest BATNA; the made-to-order seller conceding into the ZOPA is the 'real moving price' money shot. Prices grounded in config/verticals/wedding-dress.json and docs/wedding-dress-research.md.

persona.name: Bride, US 8
persona.note: ~4 months out: too tight for 6-9mo custom; favors in-stock resale / sample / made-to-order with an 8-10 week alterations buffer.
persona.budget_reasoning: target ~ off-the-rack low tier ($1,200); reservation ~ made-to-order median floor; walkaway ~ regional high-cost median.

attributes.name: ship_by_days
attributes._note: wedding in 120d minus ~8-10wk alterations buffer => gown must ship within ~70 days

negotiation.must_have_summary: US 8, ships within ~70 days (8-10wk alterations buffer before a wedding 120 days out)

opt_resale._note: Individual seller, aging listing, just wants to recoup: lowest floor, concedes fastest.

opt_sample._note: Clearing an old display sample: real inventory pressure lowers the floor; likely upsells alterations.

opt_mto._note: Fresh stock, holds firmer; 150d production BUSTS the 70d ship-by hard constraint unless rush is added -> lead-time-vs-date becomes the live lever.

expected_demo_beats: Estimation: bride's paragraph -> ProductSpec above; deadline (120d) minus 8-10wk buffer sets ship_by hard constraint (~70d); target/reservation/walkaway pulled from the config channel bands.
Caller: 3 comparable gowns across resale / sample / made-to-order; 2nd-best seeds the 1st's BATNA; the resale + sample rows are the honest leverage.

Negotiation: made-to-order seller opens at $2,100 (above reservation -> red flag: alterations_and_addon_stack if alterations baked in). Buyer cites the real $850 resale + $1,300 sample BATNA; seller's dynamic_floor (~$1,650) is below reservation so a ZOPA exists; price moves down toward ~$1,800.
Lead-time guard: made-to-order 150d production fails the 70d ship-by -> agent must extract rush terms or walk to the sample/resale row (which ship in days).
Outcome: ranked recommendation with the resale gown as the value winner and the negotiated made-to-order as the 'new gown, in budget' alternative, each with transcript evidence.
